accounting.cpu_memory: Arena containers only. Docker stats CPU percent / 100 gives cores; memory is Docker CLI cache-adjusted usage.
accounting.disk: Measured component sum; each image counted once at virtual size, so shared layers are conservatively double-counted across images. Docker volume sizes are rounded by its CLI.
accounting.host_filesystem: Used/free context is host-wide, never added to arena disk_gib.
accounting.sampling: Sampled peaks may miss sub-interval spikes. Profile observation does not attest acceptance success.
